name: Letta
summary: Letta (formerly MemGPT) builds stateful agents whose memory, identity and conversations persist over time. Since March 2026 its main product is Letta Code, a model-agnostic agent harness with git-tracked memory files, skills, subagents and messaging channels; the older Letta V1 API server is archived. Agents run locally or with state kept in Letta Cloud.
facts: TypeScript (Letta Code); install via npm, uv or pipx
~3.7k GitHub stars on letta-code; ~25k on the archived letta repo
Memory blocks in git-tracked files (MemFS), self-editing
Built-in (general-purpose, forked, recall); agents can call other agents
Free tier; Pro and API plans from $20/month
goodFor: Long-lived agents that learn across sessions
Memory you can inspect and version with git
One agent reachable from CLI, web and chat apps
watchOut: March 2026 pivot deprecated many V1 server features
Letta Cloud is the default backend; local mode is opt-in
Remote computers and secrets require a Letta sign-in
